text_block_list.text:
■ Stage Direction
SFX: Cicadas chirping

★ Request
Fade to black

Here's a little present from me to you.
Go on, take a look at the sunset reflecting off the ocean—

This adventure, and this view.
This is what I wanted to show you all along!
Like I'd have any clue about that!
Will we ever make it back safely—
I'll keep showin' you all sorts of sights from here on out.
Calming my confused mind, I desperately tried to recall how we got here—

Summer training camp. A sleepaway intensive camp held at a seaside training facility
by Tracen Academy to hone the Umamusume's skills—

You did pretty well keepin' up with me.
Not bad at all.

Hey now, you've been quiet for a while.
We're about to start bug catching, you know?

AHAHAHA!!
Oh man, this is crazy fun!!

WOOOOO!!
Our adventure!! Starts right here, right now!!

I'm Gold Ship's Trainer.
What kind of trainer would I be if I couldn't keep up with her free spirit?!

So let's aim for it together!
To become the ultimate treasure hunters...!!

Oho?! Look at you, saying cool stuff!
You've really grown up!

WOOOOO!!
Let's do thissss!!

Well, I just made all that up on the spot.
Pretty cool though, right?

We were supposed to go to a seaside training facility,
but where I ended up with Gold Ship was... a "forest."

Charge straight through, Trainer!
Don't follow the path—the path is forged wherever we blaze through!!

Well, poison or no poison,
it's not like that's gonna stop us anyway!

Follow me, Trainer!
We're changin' spots!

Let's go, Trainer!
Off to discover undiscovered treasures, awaaay we go!
Alright, didn't forget a thing! Let's roll!

Ngh—*BZZT! BZZT! Golshi Radar pinging! Ping detected!*
The ruins are that way!

A forest! Unless it's a forest where rhinoceros beetles and stags engage in fierce battles over tree sap,
my latent powers won't awaken!
Let's hurry up and head to that forest over there to catch bugs~!!

The ocean stretched out before us... The water shimmering in the sunset looked just like
fans cheering at a Winning Live.

Alrighty, how 'bout we sprint right into the sunset!
A true Umamusume's gotta run the moment she sees a sunset!

No, this won't do!!
This isn't nearly good enough—!

No... Gold Ship here
isn't the kind of Umamusume to simply accept what's handed to her!

WHAAAT?!?!?
The heck is that, sounds crazy fun!!
The two of us sprinted down the densely wooded, steep slope.

Ooh, rainbow mushroom spotted.
Hey, hey, d'ya think we can eat that?

Pushing our way through the dense trees,
our grand summer adventure with Gold Ship began—!!

Utterly bewildered, I somehow managed
to make it back to Tracen Academy...

...Wait, WHOAAA~! Is that a cliff?!
I CAN'T STOOOOOP~~~~!!!!

Hell yeah!! Green as far as the eye can see!!
Our summer training camp officially begins now!!

Something wasn't right. I was supposed to be at summer training camp,
but before I knew it, I was exploring deep inside a forest with Gold Ship.

I still had no idea what she was talking about, but through this adventure,
I felt like... Gold Ship and I grew a little closer.
............Or so it was supposed to be.

Boarding pass, check. Cards, shogi,
chess, and go to play on the plane, check.

Ripples! Winds! Extreme cold wave!!
The sea is calling to me!

—Hm, a fork in the road.
Right path, or left path...

*pant*, *pant*... Running around this much
has even got the great Golshi-chan exhausted.
